epic_text:
Epic: Billing & Subscription System
As a platform owner, I want automated billing so that customers are charged correctly.

AC1: Monthly subscription billing on 1st of each month
AC2: Usage-based billing for API calls (overage charges)
AC3: Invoice generation with PDF download
AC4: Failed payment retry (3 attempts over 7 days)
AC5: Subscription upgrade/downgrade proration
prd_text: Billing system integrating with Stripe for payments. Must handle subscriptions, usage metering, and invoice generation. Tax calculation via TaxJar. Failed payments trigger dunning emails.
architecture_text: Microservice: billing-service in Python/FastAPI. PostgreSQL for subscription data, Redis for metering counters, Stripe webhooks for payment events. Event-driven with Kafka for billing events.
